headlines.title: David Crowley upsets democratic socialist Francesca Hong in Wisconsin governor primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Crowley, the Milwaukee County executive backed by Gov. Tony Evers, narrowly defeated Hong, a democratic socialist state lawmaker, in the key battleground state.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP Senate primary runoff in South Carolina
headlines.description: Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, will face another Republican in an Aug. 25 runoff for the party’s nomination, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP Senate primary runoff in South Carolina
headlines.description: Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, will face another Republican in an Aug. 25 runoff for the party’s nomination, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Minnesota GOP picks Lisa Demuth over Trump-backed Mike Lindell for governor against Democrat Amy Klobuchar
headlines.description: Demuth, the state House speaker, defeated Trump-endorsed Lindell for the Republican nomination, NBC News projects, while Klobuchar romped in her primary.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. John Larson loses his primary to opponent calling for generational change
headlines.description: The 14-term Connecticut Democrat lost to former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin in a heavily blue district, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: Flanagan defeated Rep. Angie Craig, NBC News projects, in yet another nominating contest that exposed Democratic ideological divides.

headlines.title: Trump says security threat spurred secret plane swap in Turkey
headlines.description: The president spoke for the first time about a previously undisclosed flight after the NATO summit in July.

headlines.title: Democrat backed by Bernie Sanders wins primary as parties prepare to battle for the House
headlines.description: Democrat Rebecca Cooke will face GOP Rep. Derrick Van Orden again in Wisconsin, NBC News projects, as both parties nominated candidates in battleground districts.

headlines.title: 'We can insist on change’: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan speaks with her supporters after defeating Rep. Angie Craig in the Democratic primary for the Senate in Minnesota, NBC News projects, a major push for her party’s progressive wing.

headlines.title: Sen. Amy Klobuchar to face Lisa Demuth in Minnesota gubernatorial general election
headlines.description: Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar and Republican Minnesota state House Speaker Lisa Demuth address their supporters after winning their respective primaries for Minnesota governor.

headlines.title: Wisconsin Democratic governor primary too close to call between Crowley, Hong
headlines.description: Votes are still being counted in the Wisconsin Democratic primary for governor, with Rep. Francesca Hong and Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley separated by only a few hundred votes. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki looks at the numbers as well as races in South Carolina, Minnesota, and Connecticut.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.
